name: What are the benefits of Low-E coatings on energy-efficient windows?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of Low-E coatings on energy-efficient windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: Low-E (low-emissivity) coatings are microscopically thin, transparent layers applied to window glass that are designed to improve thermal performance. In sunny climates like Southern California, Low-E coatings primarily help by reflecting solar heat away from your home in the summer, reducing air conditioning load and keeping interiors cooler. In cooler months, they help retain heat inside the home, improving warmth. This dual action contributes significantly to lower energy bills and a more comfortable indoor environment year-round, while also protecting furnishings from UV fading.
acceptedAnswer.description: Low-E coatings reflect solar heat to keep homes cooler in summer and retain heat in winter, reducing energy use and protecting interiors from UV rays.
